fields.fieldText: Custom Rule Using Called Number

fields.name: Escalate_to_Tier_2_Content_01
fields.fieldText:
Escalate to Tier 2


Since the settings have been confirmed to be correct and the issue does not appear to be a Call Forwarding matter, This needs to be escalated to Tier 2 for further investigation. 



Reminders before escalating the case:


   • Probe if the customer has other unresolved issues. Take ownership and appropriate action to ensure unresolved issues are handled correctly.

   • Ensure that your case notes are detailed and concise.

   • Set expectations with the customer regarding their case being escalated.

   • Gather all call samples including the results based on the test calls, include them in your case notes.


NOTE: Make sure to check with your Supervisor and/or Support prior to escalating the case. 




Click "Next" to add notes to an existing case or to create a new case for this issue
